A1.justification: Local reading tools remained unresponsive and returned no PDF content. Although the supplied filenames identify versions of the same arXiv work, their contents and completeness, including appendices, could not be verified.

before.justification: v1.pdf could not be inspected, so the presence of original empirical results in its main text or appendices is unresolved.

after.justification: v3.pdf could not be inspected, so the presence of original empirical results in its main text or appendices is unresolved.

M1.justification: No method descriptions or equations were accessible; changes to the algorithm, architecture, objectives, or inference procedure cannot be determined.

E1.justification: The training and evaluation content was inaccessible, preventing comparison of datasets, tasks, domains, and test scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparison tables and experimental passages could not be read, so evaluated baseline membership cannot be matched across versions.

E3.justification: Experimental settings were unavailable, preventing assessment of changes to splits, metrics, budgets, preprocessing, or testing procedures.

E4.justification: Neither the main text nor appendices could be inspected for ablations, robustness tests, sensitivity analyses, or case studies.

E5.justification: Run counts, seed information, uncertainty estimates, and statistical procedures could not be inspected or compared.

E6.justification: No results tables, figures, or findings were accessible. Numerical changes and added or removed results cannot be verified.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, derivations, and proofs were inaccessible, leaving their presence and any substantive revisions unresolved.

C1.justification: The abstracts, introductions, and conclusions could not be read, preventing comparison of core claims and contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations, mechanism explanations, applicability boundaries, and limitations could not be inspected.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information was inaccessible, so changes in documented details or resource access cannot be established.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions and reference lists could not be read, preventing assessment of citation or research-positioning changes.

P1.justification: No document text was available to compare wording, terminology, explanations, or section organization.

P2.justification: PDF pages could not be visually inspected, so changes to figures, tables, captions, and layout cannot be determined.

improvement.justification: Neither PDF yielded readable evidence through the local tools. Without inspecting the papers and appendices, a reliable judgment of overall quality improvement or deterioration is impossible.
